nodes.name: braid
nodes.supporting_text: Braid is a Rust 2024 agent platform whose workspace members are declared in Cargo.toml:1-17.

nodes.name: braid cli
nodes.supporting_text: braid-cli and braid-tui are composition roots depending on the adapter crates.

nodes.name: braid context
nodes.supporting_text: braid-providers, braid-redact, braid-hooks, braid-observe, and braid-context depend on braid-ports and braid-model through their Cargo.toml manifests.

nodes.name: braid engine
nodes.supporting_text: braid-engine depends on braid-ports and braid-model and implements the generic agent loop, Planner interaction, and tool registry.

nodes.name: braid hooks
nodes.supporting_text: braid-providers, braid-redact, braid-hooks, braid-observe, and braid-context depend on braid-ports and braid-model through their Cargo.toml manifests.

nodes.name: braid observe
nodes.supporting_text: braid-providers, braid-redact, braid-hooks, braid-observe, and braid-context depend on braid-ports and braid-model through their Cargo.toml manifests.

nodes.name: braid ports
nodes.supporting_text: braid-ports depends on braid-model and defines Provider, ToolExecutor, Redactor, EventSink, SessionStorage, ContextProvider, Hook, and ComponentRegistry contracts.

nodes.name: braid providers
nodes.supporting_text: braid-providers, braid-redact, braid-hooks, braid-observe, and braid-context depend on braid-ports and braid-model through their Cargo.toml manifests.

nodes.name: braid redact
nodes.supporting_text: braid-providers, braid-redact, braid-hooks, braid-observe, and braid-context depend on braid-ports and braid-model through their Cargo.toml manifests.

nodes.name: braid tui
nodes.supporting_text: braid-cli and braid-tui are composition roots depending on the adapter crates.

nodes.name: cargo nextest
nodes.supporting_text: The required gates include cargo nextest run --workspace (AGENTS.md; .github/workflows/ci.yml:12-39).

nodes.name: hexagonal architecture
nodes.supporting_text: The architecture follows hexagonal architecture with model and ports inside, adapters outside, and CLI/TUI composition roots.

nodes.name: hooked executor
nodes.supporting_text: HookedExecutor runs pre-hooks, executes a tool, and runs post-hooks (crates/braid-hooks/src/executor.rs:25-48).

nodes.name: provider
nodes.supporting_text: Engine passes redacted requests to Provider (crates/braid-engine/src/engine.rs:84-200).

nodes.name: session store
nodes.supporting_text: SessionStore implements event persistence as per-session JSONL (crates/braid-observe/src/store.rs:201-220).

nodes.name: tool executor
nodes.supporting_text: Engine dispatches tool calls through ToolExecutor (crates/braid-engine/src/engine.rs:84-200).
